name: Shotari
tagline: Shotari is a free online AI photo editor
description: Shotari is a free online AI photo editor. Edit, transform, and enhance any photo in seconds with text prompts. Supports 11 languages, background removal, old photo restoration, and product photo generation. Built-in models: GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, and Nano Banana Pro. No signup required for the first generation.
